info.title: SatStacker Engine Partner API
info.description: Embed Smart Timing using partner-scoped test/live API keys. Plan and instruction USD amounts limit total customer debit INCLUDING exchange fees. Confirm actual all-in USD debit and net BTC credited; partner_fee_usd is the fee breakdown already inside that debit. SatStacker does not execute exchange orders. Only final exchange outcomes may be confirmed. Lease redelivery retains identity. See /execution-contract, /sandbox-testing and /operations in the partner docs.

get.description: Public health check. No authentication required.
Returns the authenticated partner and API key environment. Useful for integration testing.

401.description: Missing, malformed, revoked or invalid API key

patch.description: Enable or disable a partner user. Disable pauses active plans and cancels/refunds never-delivered instructions. Delivered instructions remain settleable and can be redelivered until final confirmation.

post.description: Register/reactivate a webhook and generate a new secret EVERY time, including unchanged URLs. Secret appears only in this response. Exclude from generic automatic retries; a lost response requires coordinated re-registration and verifier update.

post.description: Create or update a full plan representation. amount_usd is the all-in window budget including exchange fees. Cancelled plans are terminal. start_date is create-only. Resets return 409 while a delivered instruction is unresolved. Omitted status/smart_timing_enabled default to active/true.

401.description: Missing, malformed, revoked or invalid API key

404.description: Record not found in this partner/environment

get.description: Lease pending or expired-lease instructions for the authenticated environment. Default lease is five minutes. Redelivery keeps execution_id and idempotency_key. Treat keys as opaque. amount_usd is the maximum total customer debit including exchange fees. Delivered instructions remain settleable after pause/cancel/off. No exchange order is placed by this API call.

401.description: Missing, malformed, revoked or invalid API key

post.description: Record a definitive exchange outcome. Filled/partial require executed_at, all-in usd_amount, net credited btc_amount and fill execution_price. Fees are already included in usd_amount. Partial is terminal: remaining exchange orders must not still be able to fill. Failed/cancelled require failure_reason and represent zero debit/BTC. Identical final payload replay succeeds; changed outcomes conflict. Never place another buy to retry confirmation.

401.description: Missing, malformed, revoked or invalid API key

404.description: Record not found in this partner/environment

get.description: Monthly aggregates based on executed_at. executed_volume_usd includes the all-in customer debit, including exchange fees; partner fees are separate. closed means the calendar period ended, not an immutable snapshot. Late confirmations can change results. Funded-user count uses plans' current Smart Timing enabled status; headline volume does not apply that plan filter.

get.description: Offset-paginated per-user totals based on executed_at. Current smart_timing_enabled status filters plan eligibility, so disabling can affect historical views. Not an order-level audit export. Preserve partner-side month-end snapshots.

partner_order_id.title: Partner Order Id
partner_order_id.description: Unique exchange order ID, or a unique local attempt ID if no order was placed. Reuse on confirmation replay.

executed_at.title: Executed At
executed_at.description: UTC definitive exchange outcome time, required for filled/partial. Optional for failed/cancelled; omitted value uses confirmation time.

usd_amount.title: Usd Amount
usd_amount.description: Actual total customer debit INCLUDING exchange fees. Positive, at most 2 decimal places; must not exceed reserved amount.

btc_amount.title: Btc Amount
btc_amount.description: Net BTC actually credited, at most 8 decimal places; excludes unrelated subsequent withdrawals.

execution_price.title: Execution Price
execution_price.description: Exchange fill price or VWAP before separate fees; stored to cents and positive after rounding.

partner_fee_usd.title: Partner Fee Usd
partner_fee_usd.description: Exchange fee already INCLUDED in usd_amount; not an additional debit. Nonnegative for filled/partial; stored to cents. Failed/cancelled record zero.

failure_reason.title: Failure Reason
failure_reason.description: Required for failed/cancelled. Omit for filled/partial.

TradeConfirmIn.title: TradeConfirmIn
TradeConfirmIn.description: Final outcomes only. Conditional required fields are encoded here; the API also enforces decimal precision, positivity, reserved-amount and lifecycle rules. See /execution-contract and /errors.

executed_at.title: Executed At
executed_at.description: UTC definitive exchange outcome time, required for filled/partial. Optional for failed/cancelled; omitted value uses confirmation time.

usd_amount.title: Usd Amount
usd_amount.description: Actual total customer debit INCLUDING exchange fees. Positive, at most 2 decimal places; must not exceed reserved amount.

btc_amount.title: Btc Amount
btc_amount.description: Net BTC actually credited, at most 8 decimal places; excludes unrelated subsequent withdrawals.

execution_price.title: Execution Price
execution_price.description: Exchange fill price or VWAP before separate fees; stored to cents and positive after rounding.

window_id.title: Window Id
window_id.description: Original budget generation ID; newly generated instructions populate it.

window_start.title: Window Start
window_start.description: Original UTC window anchor for this instruction.

tranche_key.title: Tranche Key
tranche_key.description: Zero-based normal tranche index or failsafe; informational, not a deduplication key.

amount_usd.title: Amount Usd
amount_usd.description: Maximum total customer debit including exchange fees for this instruction.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Opaque attempt deduplication key; unchanged on lease redelivery. Do not construct or parse.

amount_usd.title: Amount Usd
amount_usd.description: All-in USD spending budget including exchange fees.

unspent_fiat_usd.title: Unspent Fiat Usd
unspent_fiat_usd.description: Available current-window budget after confirmed all-in debits and open reservations. This is a logical budget, not custody of funds.

amount_usd.title: Amount Usd
amount_usd.description: All-in total customer debit budget per window, including exchange fees.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Create-only UTC anchor; omit for updates. Changing the existing anchor conflicts.

subscription_rate_usd_per_user.description: USD decimal string with two places

volume_rate_bps.description: USD decimal string with two places

executed_volume_usd.description: USD decimal string with two places

subscription_fee_total.description: USD decimal string with two places

volume_fee_total.description: USD decimal string with two places

total_due.description: USD decimal string with two places

executed_volume_usd.description: USD decimal string with two places
